BiblicalUsage: zâman means to fix (a time). In Ezra 10:14 we read, "Let now our rulers of all the congregation stand..." It appears again in Nehemiah 10:34: "And we cast the lots among the priests, the Levites, and the people, for the wood offering..."
TheologicalSignificance: zaman is to fix (a time), and I take it as one more sign that Scripture rewards close reading.
